apps.subtitle: 开幕 · 零门槛「滑动解锁变身 + 动态锁屏」壁纸工坊
apps.localizedDescription: Camlo（开幕）是一款零门槛 iOS / iPadOS 原生 Core Animation (.tendies / CAML) 动态与滑动变身锁屏制作工坊。内置 120Hz 原生 .ca 实时交互试穿、陀螺仪 3D 裸眼视差 (ParameterizedCA)、昼夜双生壁纸 (appearanceAware)、智能时钟配色字体与主屏柔焦配套、6 套内置获奖风光双态预设与 70 套零体积馆藏大师级官方云端壁纸、8 款异形粒子与体积流光特效、AI 主体抠图遮挡时钟、视频/实况抽帧无缝循环与免电脑一键直写 iOS 26 / iOS 27 锁屏画廊。

versions.localizedDescription:
## Camlo v1.3.4 (Build 27)

### 彻底修复 iOS 真机锁屏景深破框不触发 (#7, #3)
- **定位并满足 `WallpaperKit` 原生景深白名单校验**：通过逆向 iOS `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`)，确认系统会在切换真机锁屏前强制检查路径中是否包含 `Clownfish` 标记（`ParameterizedCA` 检查 `wallpaper.ca` 所在 `.wallpaper` 路径；`LayeredAnimation` 检查 `floatingAnimationFileNameKey` 指向的 `Floating.ca` 路径）；若不满足，系统即记录 `Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view` 并将前景层降级压到系统时间之后（导致在 Camlo App 内能遮挡 `09:41`，回到系统真机锁屏却总是时间压人物）。
- **双引擎与历史壁纸自动原地自愈**：现已全面升级 3D `ParameterizedCA`（`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper`）与滑动变身/实况 `LayeredAnimation`（`7400.Clownfish_WWDC_2022-...wallpaper` / `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`）；**已保存在金库或外部导入的旧版 `.tendies` 壁纸**在升级至 `v1.3.4` 后会自动原地自愈迁移，无需重新创作。

### 重塑 3D 陀螺仪 (`ParameterizedCA`) 立体视差与消重影 (#3)
- **消除主体背后「双重轮廓重影」**：将背景 (`BG`) 与前景抠图 (`FG`) 的静止超采样倍率对齐为严格 `1:1`（`1.065x`），彻底解决旧版 `1.104x` 与 `1.052x` 尺寸不一致导致静止或晃动时人物头部、剑柄外侧露出一圈较大残影的问题。
- **自动背景遮挡补全 (Occlusion Inpainting)**：在编译 3D 陀螺仪壁纸及金库自愈旧包时，自动对被前景抠图遮住的背景区域执行多尺度金字塔与水平扫线上下文补全，晃动手机错位时背后露出自然衔接的天空/云海/背景纹理，不再出现克隆人影。
- **增加 `sublayerTransform` 3D 透视与立体倾斜**：收窄合理平移幅度并加入 `transform.rotation.x` / `transform.rotation.y` 空间倾角变换，还原接近原生的立体视差体验。
- **云端全部 76 套官方 `.tendies` 同步升级**：涵盖「次元 3D」「海岸海报 3D」「iPhone Duo」「馆藏名画」共 76 套官方云端包已全部重新编译并通过 `CAPackage` 与 SHA-256 校验。

---

### Fix On-Device Lock Screen Clock-Depth (#7, #3)
- **Satisfies `WallpaperKit` `Clownfish` Depth Gate**: Disassembling `WallpaperKit.framework` (`supportsDepthEffect`) confirmed that iOS collapses `FLOATING` behind the system clock (`"Depth not supported, collapsing floating view into foreground view"`) unless `"Clownfish"` appears in the `ParameterizedCA` bundle path or `LayeredAnimation` `Floating.ca` path. Both Camlo compilers (`7920.Camlo_Clownfish_3D-...wallpaper` & `7400.WWDC_2022_Clownfish_Floating-...ca`), all 76 cloud `.tendies` packs, and automatic in-place Vault/import self-healing now conform cleanly.

### Overhaul 3D Gyroscope (`ParameterizedCA`) Spatial Depth & Ghosting Fix (#3)
- **Exact 1:1 Rest Registration (`1.065x`)**: Aligns `Camlo_BG_Overscan` and `Camlo_FG_Overscan` scale identically so subjects register pixel-for-pixel at neutral rest.
- **Exterior-Inward Background Occlusion Inpainting**: Automatically inpaints the occluded region behind `cutout_lock.png` / `cutout_unlock.png` in background JPEGs so tilting reveals continuous background scenery instead of a duplicated ghost silhouette.
- **True 3D Perspective Tilt**: Adds `sublayerTransform` perspective projection (`m34 = -0.0010`), matched `zPosition="0"` parallax planes, and subtle `transform.rotation.x/y` angular tilt alongside tight balanced translation.

> ⚠️ **iOS Compatibility Reminder**: On-device Computer-Free Direct Write supports **iOS / iPadOS 26.0 – 27.3 beta 1** (Apple patched `worse_query` in `27.3 beta 2`). Creation, 120Hz preview, and `.tendies` export continue to work on all versions.

# Cloudn 1.4.2

这一版新增 SideStore / AltStore 侧载软件源支持，修复 Instagram 网页登录点「完成」卡住的问题，并带来多项稳定性、解析与性能优化。

## 新增与改进

- **SideStore / AltStore 软件源**：新增 [altstore.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/Cloudn/main/altstore.json) 订阅源并在发版时自动更新；在「设置 › 更新 › 添加侧载软件源」中可一键添加到 SideStore / AltStore 或复制源地址。
- **Instagram 网页登录修复**：支持从 `sessionid` 提取用户 ID 并补全 `ds_user_id`，实时合并页面 `document.cookie`，放宽非登录页重定向时的校验误判，并在未检测到登录态或校验失败时弹出明确提示。
- **并发与稳定性优化**：加强下载与解析任务防重入保护、完善各网盘/视频解析器与分享扩展边界处理，提升列表滚动、实时活动与无障碍体验。

## 安装

推荐通过 SideStore / AltStore 订阅本仓库软件源直接接收更新；也可下载下方附件里的 `Cloudn-v1.4.2.ipa` 自行签名后安装（需要 iOS 17 及以上）。

## Erosion-CN v1.0.6 (Build 31)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **General Splash Ad Blocker Whitelist & Manual Manager (`AdWhitelistStore` / `AdWhitelistManagerSheet`) / 去广告应用与路径通用白名单及手动管理面板** *(Thanks to [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) for suggesting [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@appleoner](https://github.com/appleoner) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 提出建议)*
   - **Dedicated Whitelist Manager (`白名单`)**：Added top-bar & Overview card entry points supporting **manual `Bundle ID` / `AppGroup ID` entry**, **quick-picking from installed third-party containers**, **manual container subpath entry**, and one-tap deletion of rules.
   - **Per-App, Per-Path & File Browser Controls**：Whitelist an entire app + its matching `group.<bundleID>` AppGroups from the container `⋯` menu, exempt a specific folder/config via the row **Ignore (`加白`)** button, or long-press any file/folder in **File Browser** → **Add to Ad Whitelist**.
   - **Auto-Skip & Auto-Restore**：Whitelisted apps and paths automatically skip global **Lock All** (`一键全锁`) and immediately restore `0755`/`0644` writable permissions (cleaning `.erosion_adlock`) when added. Includes a removable default crash-guard entry for **SMZDM (`什么值得买` · `com.smzdm.client.ios`)**.

2. **Built-In Taobao Splash Boot Paths / 内置手机淘宝开屏启动图与配置路径识别** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for sharing in [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 实测反馈)*
   - Added `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImagebiz` and `Documents/TBDocuments/bootImageDoc` for **Taobao (`com.taobao.taobao4iphone`)**, enabling automatic detection and one-tap anti-recreate `0555`/`0444` locking alongside `TanxAd`, `TanxSDK`, and `SplashAd`.

3. **Native Battery Cycle & Manufacture Date Guard on iPhone 15+ & Modern iPads / iPhone 15 系列及以上电池循环原生支持提示** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for reporting [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#55](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/55) 反馈)*
   - Automatically detects models that natively show Battery Cycle Count and Manufacture Date in iOS/iPadOS 17.4+ Settings (iPhone 15 series+ and M2/M4+ iPads), locking `[Beta] Show Battery Cycle Count & Manufacture Date on Legacy Devices` when disabled or advising users to turn it off if previously enabled.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

# HGhubX v2.2.3

本版重新安排手机播放控件，改善桌面子页的宽屏布局，并优化「我的」内容管理与吃瓜详情的稳定性。

## **TV 端无任何改动**

## 新增与优化

1. **手机播放控件与全屏手势（#170）**：选集、静音、切集开关和全屏集中到屏幕底部；首页四个按钮使用更透明的底色，减少对画面的遮挡。横屏设置抽屉完整显示倍速选项；全屏支持上下滑切集并提示首尾边界，清屏时保留锁屏入口。
2. **播放详情、标签与搜索（#170）**：「详情」和「选集」支持左右滑动切换，下拉关闭；点按标签查看同类，长按或右键可屏蔽。在栏目内打开的播放页可按当前内容类型搜索，首页底部的全局搜索不受影响。
3. **收藏与观看历史管理（#168、#169）**：在「我的」中长按或右键卡片进入多选，可批量取消收藏或删除观看记录；列表接近底部时自动加载更多，网格列数保持不变。

## 修复

1. **吃瓜详情闪烁（#165）**：切换线路或代理时保留已展示的正文和滚动位置；阅读位置更新时复用未变的图片，短暂缓冲不再立即弹出加载动画。
2. **桌面子页顶栏两侧断开（#171）**：「排行榜」「关注」等子页和页内搜索层的顶栏底色、分隔线铺满面板；标题、筛选项和正文仍按原宽度居中。
3. **本人主页与批量操作**：本人主页隐藏「关注」入口；批量取消收藏期间切换账号、线路或代理时，旧批次停止发送后续项目，不显示旧批次的结果。

## 安装与兼容提示

- Windows 提供安装程序和便携包；macOS 提供通用架构 DMG；Linux 提供 amd64 DEB。
- Android 标准版和 TV 版分别提供 APK，按设备架构选择 `arm64`、`armv7` 或 `x86_64`。覆盖升级请选相同版本类别，避免卸载造成应用数据丢失。
- iOS 提供未签名 IPA，需自行签名并侧载。收藏「新更 N 集」的提醒基线仍按设备记录，不跨设备同步。

## 致谢

- 感谢 @makisekurisu-jp 对手机播放和「我的」页面的贡献；本版由 @zxsos 整合、验证并发布，也感谢反馈桌面布局和吃瓜闪烁问题的用户。

## 验证

- [候选版 CI #44678989121](https://github.com/zxsos/HGhubX/actions/runs/44678989121)：标准版与 TV 版前端构建通过；Rust 114 项通过、4 项忽略；浏览器 smoke 7／7 通过；播放核心 7／7、扩展 4／4 通过。浏览器回归确认连续划到第 2、3 集时未跳到其他剧。

versions.localizedDescription:
# What's New in Mori 4.6.0

### New Features & Enhancements

* **Built-in Offline & Online Tools Suite**: Dedicated utility tab featuring a live browser media sniffer (HLS & stream interception with tracker/ad filtering), offline video-to-audio extractor (WAV/MP3 via Web Audio API), client-side image converter & compressor (WebP/JPG/PNG), PDF document compressor, multi-platform username checker (20+ networks), anime scene reverse search (trace.moe), TikTok profile inspector, and shortlink resolver.
* **In-App APK Updater & Direct GitHub Installs**: Direct in-app update flow for Android detecting new GitHub releases, displaying localized changelog popups across 9 languages, and downloading APKs with in-app progress ring and package installer trigger.
* **Platform-Specific iOS Update Routing**: Tailored update modal for iOS detecting platform environment, calculating `.ipa` package size, and routing users directly to `.ipa` browser download or GitHub Release page.
* **Template-Based Filenames & Persistent Counters (#21)**: Custom file naming patterns (`{platform}`, `{date}`, `{time}`, `{quality}`, `{num}`, `{title}`) with monotonic sequential counters per platform.
* **Real-Time Download Progression (#22)**: Enhanced progress tracking for chunked streams with live byte counters, transfer speed, connection stall detection, and storage write status.
* **Android MediaStore & Gallery Instant Sorting**: Scans newly downloaded media with refreshed timestamps so files appear at the top of device gallery and music apps under "Recent" or "Today".

### Bug Fixes & Scraper Repairs

* **YouTube Server 2 Migration**: Migrated YouTube Server 2 to `ytmp3.gl` (`api.ytmp3.gl`) for reliable MP3 and MP4 stream conversions.
* **Bilibili Multi-Part Parameter Preservation (#23)**: Preserved `?p=` episode parameter when sanitizing Bilibili URLs so multi-part video links aren't deduped into part 1 during batch downloads.
* **Concurrent Downloads & Wake-Lock (#24)**: Fixed Android foreground service and wake-lock terminating prematurely when multiple downloads run concurrently.
* **Share History Limits (#24)**: Aligned ShareActivity history truncation with user-configured `mori_history_limit` so favorited items are preserved.
* **Background State Exception (#24)**: Fixed missing `pauseAllMedia` import throwing ReferenceError when the app enters the background.
* **Preview Modal Missing File Status**: Fixed false `(File missing)` status on audio and music cards by mapping audio MIME types dynamically, rendering proper music placeholders, and detecting media readiness via HTML5 audio events.
* **Upstream Security Upgrade (#25)**: Upgraded `proxy-addr` to 2.0.8 resolving CVE vulnerability.

### Performance & Reliability

* **Stale OTA Patch Auto-Purge (#24)**: Automatically purges legacy or stale OTA scraper patches when a newer bundled core version is detected.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/coflyn/Mori/compare/v4.5.2...v4.6.0

> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).

# Worse Query Files 0.9.19

A small fix release, plus optional App Store icons.

## New

- **Settings → App Store Icons** (off by default): other apps' icons can't be read with worse_query, so WQ Files can fetch them from Apple's public App Store lookup instead. This sends the bundle ids of your installed apps and your region to Apple. Sideloaded apps and apps that were removed from the App Store keep the placeholder. Icons are stored in WQ Files (about 7 KB each, not backed up); turning the setting off deletes them.

## Fixed

- **Apps with one-word bundle ids** like Pinterest (`pinterest`) showed "container identity unavailable" and 0 KB, and couldn't be opened, backed up or cleared. They work now.
- **App icons:** other apps' icons can't be read with worse_query, so they show a placeholder. Third-party apps now all get the neutral one, instead of misleading guesses like the Books icon for Facebook or the Music icon for TikTok. Apple services that iOS only gives a placeholder for no longer show iOS's grey grid in dark mode.
- **Apps list on iOS 27:** the header above the list (number of apps and their size) showed as an empty band, leaving a large gap. It shows its text again, with less space above it.
- **iOS 27 beta 5 / public beta 3** ([#70](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/70)): after swiping back from App Backups, the first row on the Backups tab stopped responding. It keeps working now. The blurred band under the bar can still look too tall on that beta; that's an iOS bug. Release versions of iOS aren't affected.
